facts.population: Published studies on implant placement and restoration in the anterior region
facts.intervention: Postsurgical steps, provisional phase, emergence profile contour, abutment types and impression techniques for esthetic implant restorations
facts.main_result: Immediate restoration depends on primary stability; delayed cases need a provisional phase to rebuild collapsed soft tissue, then customized impression coping, soft material injection around the provisional in the master cast, or digital impression to transfer the gingival architecture.
facts.key_finding: Narrative review of postsurgical prosthetic soft tissue management around anterior implants: healing and definitive abutment options, provisional contour management, and four ways to transfer peri-implant soft tissue shape (customized coping, emergence profile cast, soft material injection in the master cast, digital impression).
facts.clinical_bottom_line: Use primary stability to decide on immediate restoration, rebuild collapsed tissue with a contoured provisional, and transfer the resulting gingival profile to the lab with a customized technique or digital impression.
